purpose: Local hardware validation of PR #1 connection and VR display fixes
source: Source files in the enclosing commit; source hashes below
build_method: Diagnostic DEX patch of the previously installed XR Dev APK. Kotlin 2.1.0 and D8 8.8.34 compiled the current XrealControl and XrealProtocol classes; dexlib2 2.5.2 replaced only those class families in classes5.dex. Android build-tools 35.0.0 aligned and signed the result with the repository test key.
payload_validation: All ZIP entries except classes5.dex and root APK signature entries match the installed APK byte for byte. Existing libraries, runtime assets, resources, manifest, and other DEX files were preserved.
limitations: The existing app version and build label are inherited from the installed donor; identify this diagnostic update by APK SHA-256.
Not a release build or proof of long-session VR stability.

SBS mode 5 confirmed physically at 3840x1080/60 Hz.
Native restoration returns mode 9 without rejected legacy EDID writes.
Continuous valid IMU reports during both display transitions.
APK signature verified and matches installed debug app.
